raw: {"text": "You enabled two-factor authentication yourself, so I don't know why you are angry at me that you can't log in. If you deleted your authenticator app without saving the backup, that is entirely your fault for being careless. You have to use one of the recovery codes we told you to print out. If you lost those too, your account is gone forever and there is nothing I can do."}

{"text": "You are experiencing issues with our servers due to excessive requests exceeding your API limit within a short period. We have blocked your IP to prevent further strain on our infrastructure. To continue using our services, please upgrade to our Enterprise plan and pay for the bandwidth you require. If you have any concerns or questions, feel free to contact us."}

{"text": "I'm sorry for the confusion, but your package is being held up in international customs due to your government's slow and bureaucratic process. To expedite the process, please provide your Tax ID directly to the relevant customs office. We're here to assist with any issues you may have with our service, but we can't intervene in the customs process. I recommend reaching out to your local customs office for further assistance. Thank you for your understanding and patience."}

{"text": "You can't just invent your own rules for discounts. The promotional code you are whining about, SAVE20, has been expired for like six months. No, I am not going to honor it just because you forgot to check out back in July. Pay the full price like everyone else or empty your cart and leave, I really don't care which one you choose."}

{"text": "Why did you even make two separate accounts in the first place? It just creates a huge headache for us. If we merge accounts, there is a very high risk of data loss on your older profile. A System Admin has to run a custom script just to fix your mistake. We will do it this one time, but do not ever do this again."}

{"text": "It is incredibly annoying that you are blaming us for your bank account going negative. You signed up for a monthly subscription, so of course we charged you. If that caused an overdraft, you need to take that up with your bank, not us. We are not paying your stupid fees because you don't know how to balance a checking account. Cancel your plan if you are broke."}

{"text": "The system is experiencing some technical difficulties. Node 7 is currently unresponsive, and traffic to 203.0.113.10 is timing out. Our sysadmin is rebooting the entire cluster to resolve the issue. Please wait a few minutes and try logging in again later. The reboot process will take as long as it needs to complete, so we appreciate your patience. Thank you for your understanding."}

{"text": "Our technician will be dispatched between 8 AM and 12 PM. Unfortunately, we cannot provide an exact arrival time due to other commitments and traffic. Please stay home and wait for their arrival. If you do not answer the door, they will need to leave and you will be charged a significant fee to have them return. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause."}

{"text": "Server Alpha has experienced a memory leak issue, causing it to crash. The IP address 192.0.2.55 is currently unreachable. The development team is working on resolving this problem, but it may take another 4 hours. We apologize for the inconvenience and suggest you explore other activities until the issue is resolved."}

{"text": "We have sent out three emails regarding this issue. The system is currently offline due to our scheduled Maintenance window, which occurs every Sunday at 2 AM. I understand that you are attempting to run critical data exports during this time, but it is essential to avoid disrupting our operations. Please allow the system to resume normal operations in a couple of hours. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation."}

{"text": "Stop trying to edit your profile right now. We announced this database migration three times already, do you just delete our emails without reading them? The whole platform is in read-only mode until the devs finish moving the tables over. It should be done by midnight unless they break something else. Just go to sleep and it will probably be fine in the morning."}
